description: Look up one International Patent Classification (IPC) symbol via WIPO IPCPUB — its English/French title, structural breakdown (section/class/subclass/group/subgroup) and whether it is a currently valid classification. Give "symbol" as a subclass ("A01N") or a full group/subgroup ("A61K 31/00"). IPC only — the related-but-different CPC scheme (EPO/USPTO) is not covered here.
name: ipc_lookup
title: Ipc Lookup
